name: Fly.io
subtitle: Global app platform (micro-VMs)
creator: Kurt Mackey and team
description: You deploy Docker images that run as lightweight Firecracker VMs close to users in many regions. It offers private networking, volumes, managed Postgres and machines that stop and start automatically.

languages.youWrite: Any language via Docker; config in fly.toml

concepts.explanation: Fast-booting VMs you pay for by the second.
One IP routes to the nearest region.

codeSamples.label: TOML · fly.toml
codeSamples.code:
app = "my-app"
primary_region = "iad"

[http_service]
  internal_port = 8080
  force_https = true
  auto_stop_machines = "stop"
  auto_start_machines = true
  min_machines_running = 0

pros: Runs real long-lived servers and WebSockets
Great fit for Elixir, Rails and Django
cons: No ongoing free allowance for new accounts

pricing.summary: Pay as you go. The smallest always-on machine (shared-cpu-1x, 256 MB) is about $2/mo. New accounts get a short trial, not a free allowance. Paid support from $29/mo.
